column1: # boru Language Specification: surfaces — pure operation contracts
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# `def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])}` declares a
# surface: a named set of required operation shapes with no bodies and
# no state, minted under Ideal/Surface. `Self` marks the positions the
# conforming type occupies. Conformance is EXPLICIT — `Circle exposes
# Shape` checks the overload table with Self := Circle substituted
# (contravariant params, covariant returns) and errors loudly
# (surface_unsatisfied, listing every gap) unless every operation is
# satisfied. Membership (sig dispatch, `is`, unify, the tor/tand/tnot
# algebra) is a parent-chain probe of the conformance set — no
# structural duck typing. See design/legacy/SURFACES.10.ignore.
# §1  declaration
def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} end Shape
column3: the name denotes its minted node and renders as the name (§6); the contract is the node's recorded content

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} end typeof Shape
column3: typeof is one Parent hop uniformly (§6; NUR094 retired)

column1: surface {}
column3: an empty schema is rejected

column1: surface {area: 1.0}
column3: operations must be fnsig shapes, not values

column1: surface [1 2]
column3: the schema must be a map (a list has no surface sig)

column1: # §2  exposes — explicit conformance, checked loudly
def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} def area fn [[c:Circle] [Float] [(c dot r) mul 2.0]] Circle exposes Shape end (make Circle {r:3.0}) is Shape
column3: a checked exposer's instances are members

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} end (make Circle {}) is Shape
column3: no exposes, no membership — even with the schema in reach

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} Circle exposes Shape
column3: a missing operation is a loud gap (name listed)

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} def area fn [[c:Circle] [String] ['big']] Circle exposes Shape
column3: a wrong return type is a loud gap

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} def area fn [[c:Circle] [Float] [1.0]] Circle exposes Shape Circle exposes Shape end (make Circle {}) is Shape
column3: re-exposing is idempotent

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} 5 exposes Shape
column3: the left side must be a type

column1: def Circle class {r:1.0} Circle exposes Integer
column3: the right side must be a surface

column1: # §3  membership — dispatch, subclasses, refined scalars

def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} def area fn [[c:Circle] [Float] [(c dot r) mul 2.0]] Circle exposes Shape def total fn [[s:Shape] [Float] [area s]] end total (make Circle {r:4.0})
column3: a surface-typed param dispatches on membership

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} def area fn [[c:Circle] [Float] [1.0]] Circle exposes Shape def Disc refine Circle {} end (make Disc {r:1.0}) is Shape
column3: subclass instances of an exposer conform

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Pos refine Integer def area fn [[p:Pos] [Float] [1.0]] Pos exposes Shape def x:Pos 5 end x is Shape
column3: a refined scalar can expose a surface

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Pos refine Integer def area fn [[p:Pos] [Float] [1.0]] Pos exposes Shape end 5 is Shape
column3: …and the bare base value does not conform (newtypes stay nominal)

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} def area fn [[c:Circle] [Float] [1.0]] Circle exposes Shape end unify Shape (make Circle {})
column3: unify admits a member

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} unify Shape 5
column3: unify rejects a non-member

column1: # §4  algebra — tor / tand / tnot ride the same membership

def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} def area fn [[c:Circle] [Float] [1.0]] Circle exposes Shape def MaybeShape (Shape tor none) end (make Circle {}) is MaybeShape
column3: a surface works as a disjunct alternative

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def MaybeShape (Shape tor none) end none is MaybeShape
column3: …with the other alternative intact

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def MaybeShape (Shape tor none) end 5 is MaybeShape
column3: …and non-members rejected

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} end Shape tand Shape
column3: a surface intersected with itself is itself

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} def area fn [[c:Circle] [Float] [1.0]] Circle exposes Shape end Circle tand Shape
column3: an exposer is wholly contained — the type side wins

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} end Integer tand Shape
column3: a non-exposer intersects to Never

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Other surface {bulk: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} end Shape tand Other
column3: distinct surfaces have no representable intersection

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def Circle class {r:1.0} def area fn [[c:Circle] [Float] [1.0]] Circle exposes Shape def NotShape (tnot Shape) end (make Circle {}) is NotShape
column3: the complement excludes members

column1: def Shape surface {area: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])} def NotShape (tnot Shape) end 5 is NotShape
column3: …and admits non-members

column1: 5 is (surface {a: (fnsig [[Self] [Float]])})
column3: an anonymous surface BODY as the is-RHS answers through the conformance set (nothing exposes it)
